metadata.methods_description: iEEG data were recorded invasively from bilateral epileptic lesion areas in RNS-implanted patients. Each recording contains 90 seconds of dual-channel iEEG (60 seconds pre-stimulation and ~30 seconds post-stimulation). Data were acquired in weekly sessions over periods exceeding six months per patient. Stimulation parameters were documented by neurosurgeons during clinical follow-ups. Data were saved in EDF format and converted to BIDS using FieldTrip (version 20250114). Technical validation included power spectral analysis, envelope length calculation, and phase locking value computation.
